relationships.subject: Docosahexaenoic acid
relationships.evidence_quote: Resolvin D1 (RvD1), derived from the omega-3 fatty acid docosahexaenoic acid, acts in a multimodal manner to modulate pain and inflammation by regulating immunological, neuronal, and glial responses.

key_findings: Review: RvD1 modulates pain and inflammation via immune, neuronal and glial responses in preclinical models.
